name: Kasbah Taourirt
hero_subtitle: Mud-brick lanes and rooftop views you can walk to from the centre.

overview.title: The Kasbah at the Heart of Town
overview.p1: Kasbah Taourirt sits right in Ouarzazate, not half an hour down a tourist road. It was a Glaoui stronghold; today the restored sections and the maze of crumbling courtyards give you the texture of a desert-edge kasbah without leaving town. Climb for the rooftop views over the modern avenues and the hills beyond.
overview.p2: Go in the morning while the alleys still hold shade. Some rooms are restored with exhibits; others are open shells. Wear closed shoes — mud brick and uneven steps are the rule.
overview.p3: An hour or two is enough for most visits. Pair it with a café in town rather than treating it as a full-day outing.

q1.question: Is there an entry fee?
q1.answer: Yes — a modest ticket is usual; confirm at the entrance.

q2.question: How long do I need?
q2.answer: 45 to 90 minutes for a calm visit.

q3.question: Is it steep?
q3.answer: Some stair sections — take your time on worn steps.

q4.question: Do I need a guide at Kasbah Taourirt?
q4.answer: Optional for a simple visit; useful for history and safe paths on fragile mud brick.

q5.question: Is Kasbah Taourirt suitable for families?
q5.answer: Yes with supervision on steps, rooftops and uneven ground.

food.title: Eat in town after the kasbah
food.p1: Little is sold inside. Plan lunch or tea on the avenues a short walk away.
food.p2: Taourirt is a monument stop, not a dining street.

food.li2: Tagine restaurant on the main avenue
food.li3: Hotel lunch if you want shade and AC
food.li4: Grilled meat in a busy local place
food.li5: Water before you climb the roofs

tips.title: Practical Tips for Visiting Kasbah Taourirt

1.title: Morning light
1.desc: Arrive early: cooler alleys, softer light on the mud walls, fewer groups.

2.title: Shoes and steps
2.desc: Closed shoes with grip — worn brick and uneven stairs are normal. Hold children on rooftop edges.

3.title: Combine with town
3.desc: Walk here from most central hotels. Add the Cinema Museum the same morning if you want a full culture block without a driver.
